0022600104.text: The Heat (0-2) come into their third game of the season on a two-game losing streak, sitting 15th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, two games back, while the Hornets (1-1) are 8th in the East and third in the Southeast, one game back. Miami is g'winning ... no. Miami is missing Pelle Larsson, who is day-to-day with a finger sprain and is a game-time decision, while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting, in Charlotte on March 17, 2026, ended in a 136-106 Hornets win.
